title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects (Early Version)
abstract: arXiv:2607.04234v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deformable object manipulation poses challenges beyond task completion: successful execution must also maintain safe physical interaction, holding the object stably without slip or drop while avoiding excessive deformation. However, existing manipulation benchmarks are predominantly success-oriented and rarely evaluate whether a policy remains physically safe throughout execution. We present SoftVTBench, a safety-aware visuo-tactile benchmark for physically constrained deformable object manipulation. translated_title: SoftVTBench：面向物理约束下可变形物体机器人操作的安全感知视觉-触觉基准（早期版本）
translated_abstract: 摘要：可变形物体操作带来的挑战不仅限于任务完成：成功的执行还必须保持安全的物理交互，即稳定地握住物体而不滑动或掉落，同时避免过度变形。然而，现有的操作基准主要面向成功导向，很少评估策略在执行过程中是否始终保持物理安全。我们提出了SoftVTBench，一个用于物理约束下可变形物体操作的安全感知视觉-触觉基准。该基准基于Isaac Sim构建，并采用有限元模拟的可变形物体，提供多视角RGB观测、带标记运动的RGB触觉感知、本体感觉和语言指令，并定义了四组匹配的任务套件，涵盖物体类型（可变形与刚性）和变化轴（物体与空间）。它分别报告目标成功率和安全成功率；后者额外要求无掉落和峰值变形限制。
tldr: SoftVTBench是首个同时评估任务完成和物理安全（防滑落、防过度变形）的可变形物体操作视觉-触觉基准，为安全感知的机器人操作提供了标准化测试平台。
en_tdlr: SoftVTBench is the first visuo-tactile benchmark that simultaneously evaluates task completion and physical safety (no slip/drop and deformation limits) for deformable object manipulation, providing a standardized testbed for safety-aware robotic operation.
